lastResponse.text: First step: call two one one now and say, “I’m in Beaverton, I have a pay-or-vacate notice, and I need eviction prevention help for about six hundred dollars this month.” I can see two one one info has an Eviction Prevention Assistance listing with multiple providers, so ask for the fastest referral and what documents they need before you call agencies.
